as_told.title: Gravity control achieved in 1954, seen in vault documents

plain: A man named Richard Foch, one of the UFO researcher Steven Greer's teammates, is said to have been inside a vault, tied to the Naval Research Laboratory, and to have seen documents giving the date the United States learned to control gravity: October 1954. Greer tells Michels this as something Foch told him: "Rick had been in the vault and saw the documents." If it were true, it would mean a technology still treated as science fiction was mastered in secret seven decades ago. In another episode, Michael Herrera, a man who says he saw a giant UFO in the Indonesian jungle, repeats the story as Greer's claim, without naming Foch or giving the month.
